entry.title: Man City found guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of financial rules, Premier League says
entry.content: A statement from the English Premier League said an independent commission found that the club had arranged "sham" contracts and agreements to artificially inflate its revenues and reduce its costs.
entry.dc:creator: Sport

entry.title: Ukraine pushes for 'bold action' on Russian assets to plug $78 billion gap in 2027
entry.content: Russia's relentless airstrikes are deepening Ukraine's financial gap. As costs rise and the deficit swells, the country is pleading with European allies to tap into the immobilised Russian assets.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: No energy shortages, but a painful winter looms for Europe, top EU energy leader warns
entry.content: Europe needs to protect consumers from another energy price shock while making fossil fuels less central to the economy. Emergency measures can soften the immediate blow, but Brussels is warning governments not to let short-term subsidies or tax decisions undermine the green transition.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Pressure grows within EPP to expel Vučić’s SNS party over Mladić funeral
entry.content: The EU’s largest political family linked the participation of senior Serbian officials at Mladić’s funeral to its ongoing scrutiny of the Serbian Progressive Party, which could ultimately lead to its suspension or expulsion from the EPP.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: With two Orbán-era ministers detained, Magyar's 'Operation Purge' takes shape
entry.content: Prime Minister Péter Magyar’s “Operation Purge” has entered a new phase with the detention of two former ministers. Holding officials from the Orbán era to account was a central campaign pledge, and Magyar says the drive will now accelerate. Fidesz has denounced the effort as political revenge.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.content: Sateliot is launching five satellites with SpaceX on Thursday, taking its constellation to 11. The Draconis mission will double daily passes, halve revisit time and bolster its 5G NTN IoT connectivity service.

entry.content: The bomber went down near Krasnoyarovo shortly after taking off from the Ukrainka air base, which Russia had used to shelter surviving strategic bombers after Ukraine's Operation Spiderweb destroyed or damaged more than 40 aircraft at Russian airfields in June 2025.

entry.title: UK PM Burnham to lay out 'options' for EU relations later this year
entry.content: The country's divisive 2016 vote to leave the EU has once again been thrust under the spotlight this year amid mounting calls from leading Labour figures for Britain to re-enter the bloc.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Global economic impact of Iran war ‘unbearable,’ Qatar warns as talks continue
entry.content: The war has choked shipping through Hormuz and disrupted Gulf exports. Qatar said it has continued to mediate between Washington and Tehran, warning that the fallout has now affected multiple sectors and not just energy.

entry.content: Miesiąc temu odsunięcie pracownic od obsługi podczas wizyty ultrakonserwatywnej grupy hinduistycznej wywołało strajk i jednodniowe zamknięcie zabytku.

entry.content: A month ago, the exclusion of female staff during a visit by an ultraconservative Hindu group sparked a strike and forced the monument to close for a day.

entry.title: Tokio notuje najdłuższą serię deszczowych dni: 34 z rzędu
entry.content: W Tokio pada nieprzerwanie od 34 dni – to najdłuższa taka seria opadów w historii pomiarów, poinformowała Japońska Agencja Meteorologiczna.

entry.title: Tokyo records longest rainy streak on record with 34 consecutive days
entry.content: Tokyo has recorded 34 consecutive days of rain, marking the longest such streak on record, according to Japan's weather agency.

entry.content: Sędzia José Luis Calama uznał, że wypowiedzi dyrektora generalnego Yanes o wartości klejnotów nie uzasadniają wyłączenia firmy z nowej wyceny.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe (PL)

entry.title: Prezes Azerbejdżańskiej Rady Turystyki: loty Baku–Bruksela od 2027 roku
entry.content: Azerbejdżan wzmacnia połączenia, uruchamiając cztery loty tygodniowo między Baku a Brukselą, a turyści powinni odkrywać też jego ukryte wioski.
entry.dc:creator: Travel (PL)

entry.title: Tylko u nas: Unijna opłata cyfrowa może przynieść UE do 25 miliardów euro rocznie
entry.content: Proponowana przez Parlament Europejski danina cyfrowa mogłaby przynieść do 25 miliardów euro rocznie na kolejny budżet UE, czyli pięć razy więcej niż szacuje Komisja – wynika z danych Danuše Nerudovej dla Euronews.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe (PL)

entry.title: Azerbaijan Tourism Board CEO: Baku-Brussels flights on the horizon for 2027
entry.content: Azerbaijan is boosting connectivity with four-weekly flights between Baku and Brussels. But beyond the capital, Azerbaijan Tourism Board CEO Florian Sengstschmid told Euronews that visitors should discover the country’s hidden villages.
entry.dc:creator: Travel

entry.title: Evicted 87-year-old Madrid pensioner can return home, says tenants union
entry.content: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction fuelled protests over Spain’s housing crisis will be able to return to her Madrid home following an agreement with the property owner.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Polska przegrała pierwszą batalię o Mercosur. Jest decyzja TSUE
entry.content: TSUE odrzucił wniosek Polski o tymczasowe zawieszenie umowy handlowej UE z Mercosurem. Warszawa argumentowała, że porozumienie może zaszkodzić rolnikom, jednak Trybunał uznał, że Polska nie wykazała ryzyka poważnej i nieodwracalnej szkody. Główna skarga Polski nadal czeka na rozpatrzenie.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe (PL)

entry.title: Seul: wybuchy północnokoreańskich min w strefie zdemilitaryzowanej naruszają rozejm
entry.content: Północna i południowa granica strefy należą do najmocniej ufortyfikowanych na świecie, a incydenty z minami lądowymi wcześniej zaostrzały napięcia między oboma państwami.
entry.dc:creator: News (PL)

entry.title: Spanish government unveils new measures aimed at easing housing crisis
entry.content: The government has been facing growing pressure from a housing protest movement amid high costs and public outcry over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Eksport ropy z Bliskiego Wschodu rośnie, więcej LNG przepływa przez cieśninę Ormuz
entry.content: Po kilku miesiącach wojny z Iranem eksporterzy z Zatoki utrzymują przepływ ropy i gazu, jednak przepłynięcie przez cieśninę Ormuz pozostaje ryzykowne, a część klientów nadal nie otrzymuje zakontraktowanych dostaw.

entry.title: Pope's visit to France is 'beginning of a new mission to Europe', expert says
entry.content: Austen Ivereigh, a fellow in Contemporary Church History at Oxford University, thinks one of the biggest themes of Pope Leo XIV's pontificate will be "to build a new world order", as he sees the old one "has crumbled".
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Middle East oil exports rise as LNG traffic through Hormuz picks up
entry.content: Months into the war with Iran, Gulf exporters are finding ways to keep oil and gas moving, but crossing Hormuz remains risky and some customers are still missing contracted cargoes.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Counterfeit medicine trade: how online pharmacies are selling deadly fake painkillers across Europe
entry.content: Deadly synthetic opioids disguised as legitimate painkillers are being sold online across Europe, as counterfeit medicines linked to multiple deaths in the Netherlands expose the dark side of e-commerce.

entry.title: Podróbki leków: apteki internetowe sprzedają zabójcze fałszywe leki przeciwbólowe w całej Europie

entry.title: Protesters march for unrestricted abortion access in Chile and Colombia
entry.content: Demonstrators gathered in Santiago and Bogotá on International Safe Abortion Day, calling for greater access to abortion and defending reproductive rights.

entry.content: The European Parliament's proposed digital levy could raise up to €25bn a year for the next EU budget, five times the Commission's estimate, according to figures shared exclusively with Euronews by MEP Danuše Nerudová.

entry.title: European Travel Commission CEO: 'Climate change is the biggest threat to tourism right now'
entry.content: While Europe remains the world’s tourism playground, Eduardo Santander of the European Travel Commission told Euronews that the continent needs to coordinate better to tackle climate challenges and congestion.

entry.title: Polo makes landfall in Mexico as Category 3 hurricane, cutting power and causing floods
entry.content: This year's Pacific hurricane season is shaping up as more severe than usual, as a Super El Niño, an extreme version of a recurring weather pattern, wreaks devastation, in the form of historic droughts and flooding.

entry.title: French students clash with police as blockades over conditions in schools intensify
entry.content: Tens of thousands were expected to rally in Paris and other cities, with teachers and fire services striking nationwide although with public transport not badly affected.

entry.content: Dekret zwiększa liczebność rosyjskiej armii o 15,5 tysięcy żołnierzy, do 1,55 miliona. To już czwarta podwyżka od marca. Wołodymyr Zełenski twierdzi, że Rosja rozpoczęła kolejną mobilizację, a Korea Północna przygotowuje się do wysłania do Rosji kolejnych 10 tysięcy żołnierzy.

entry.content: Bill White, Ambassador of the United States to Belgium, told Euronews that Belgian travellers could soon breeze through major US airports as Global Entry plans move forward.
